sections.name: SavedApplication
sections.title: Reopening a saved job without regenerating
sections.what: When a saved job opens, this loads its status, its report and whichever saved content applies: the combined 3D programme, one project model, or the schedule-only list. It shows a loading message while reading, and an error with a Try again button if reading fails.
sections.why: Likely reason: reopening must never rebuild anything, so the screen only reads saved data and says that nothing was regenerated.
sections.watch_out: The load runs again when the job, the project or the retry counter changes, so changing those dependencies changes when the screen reloads.
